items.title: EU DeFi proposals could push users to riskier platforms, says Coinbase exec
items.summary: Coinbase’s EU policy chief says applying suitability tests beyond crypto lending and borrowing could limit access and fragment liquidity.

items.title: OKXICE moves ahead with tokenized stocks as blue chips push back
items.summary: The Nov. 23 debut puts a new SEC exemption to the test as Nasdaq pursues its own tokenized stock plans after warning that trading across platforms could fragment liquidity.

items.title: DTCC adds Solana to Wall Street tokenization plans, targeting 2027 rollout
items.summary: The securities infrastructure giant plans to bring tokenized stocks, ETFs and U.S. Treasuries to Solana as it expands next year's roadmap beyond Stellar and Arc.

items.title: Jupiter adds Anchorage-backed USDGO to its $1 billion Solana lending platform
items.summary: OSL offers a yield on USDGO only to professional investors, but Jupiter said its market lets other holders earn onchain at rates set by borrower demand.

items.title: The next Congress will write rules for AI and emerging tech. They should use the stuff first.
items.summary: The best thing industry leaders can do is to invest the time to ensure this country’s policymakers can experience the technology they’re regulating up close, writes Allie Page, executive director of American Innovation Project.

items.title: Nvidia CEO Huang quits company he co-founded, led for 3 decades. Shares slump
items.summary: CFO Colette Kress takes over as interim CEO after Huang steps down immediately as president, chief executive and board member, as shares tumble.

items.title: Bitcoin weakness erases September's bullish signal
items.summary: Your day-ahead look for Nov. 12, 2026

items.title: UK bank Griffin raises $20 million to expand into stablecoin payments
items.summary: The Series B funding round, led by Octagon Partners valued the London-based company at more than $100 million.

items.title: Ethereum researchers drop faster blocks to race toward quantum defenses in 2027
items.summary: Ethlabs wants quantum-resistant accounts targeted for next year, even if wallet holders still have to switch signing methods themselves.

items.title: Bitcoin dips with Nvidia as ETF outflows reach day five
items.summary: Bitcoin slips 0.7% as Nvidia falls on reports its board may oust CEO Jensen Huang, while U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs lose another $299.9 million.

items.title: Polymarket trims workforce under investor pressure as Kalshi surges ahead
items.summary: More than half of those affected were contractors, a source told Reuters. The cuts follow investor pressure on founder Shayne Coplan.

items.title: Nomura weighs Laser Digital sale as European losses hit four straight quarters
items.summary: The Japanese brokerage has held talks with potential buyers, including Marex, as its European business posts more losses.

items.title: India’s financial crimes watchdog raids crypto exchanges CoinDCX and Delta over alleged illegal cross-border trades
items.summary: The Enforcement Directorate alleged illegal cross-border flows that violated India's foreign exchange laws.

items.title: Live updates: Bitcoin slumps below $72,000 as Nvidia's Huang resigns, interest rates surge
items.summary: The Fed continued amping up its hawkishness on Thursday; meanwhile, existing home sales fell to their weakest level in 16 years.

items.title: Gemini sells UK and European operations to stablecoin payments firm KAST for under $10 million
items.summary: The sale follows the Winklevoss-founded crypto exchange’s retreat from several overseas markets as it restructures its business.

items.title: Canaan may sell more bitcoin for stock buybacks as mining-rig revenue falls 96%
items.summary: The Avalon maker has launched a $20 million repurchase program, while most of its bitcoin holdings were pledged or placed in a fixed-term product at September’s end.

items.title: MSCI is dropping Strategy from its index, and the exclusion could hit its bitcoin-buying machine
items.summary: MSCI’s decision to exclude Strategy from its equity indexes could hamper the company’s ability to buy more bitcoin, according to some analysts.

items.title: Zcash holders to vote on pulling 50,000 ZEC, worth $50 million, from grants treasury
items.summary: The proposal would remove more than half of Zcash Community Grants' ZEC holdings from circulation and redirect its future block rewards into a new development and legal-defense fund.

items.title: Bitcoin Core reveals bug that made thousands of nodes trust any stranger on Tor
items.summary: The flaw was fixed in October 2025 and kept quiet until Tuesday. It came out alongside a high-severity bug that could stop a miner from producing blocks until someone restarted it.

items.title: Ripple’s bank-lending system moves closer to launch on the XRP Ledger
items.summary: Lending support among the ledger’s 35 validators has climbed from 19 to 22 since mid-October, and no public tracker shows which validators switched.
